title: Quick Leave
description: Instantly leave any server with a single key. Fast, simple, and efficient. is very good
body:
## Quick Leave

A small and simple mod that lets you leave a server instantly with a key.

No menus, no setup:
press the key and you're back to the main menu.

### How to use

- Go to Controls
- Change the key if you want (default: F8)
- Press it in-game → you leave the server

### Why?

Because sometimes… you just need to leave fast
